robotdataprocess.conversion_utils.col_to_dec_arr(collection: ndarray[Any, dtype[ScalarType]] | list) → ndarray[Any, dtype[Decimal]]

This helper method maps collections (such as arrays or lists) into an np.ndarray of Decimal objects for easy operations and high-fidelity numbers.

Parameters:

collection (np.ndarray | list) – A sequential collection of numbers.

Returns:

A numpy array with Decimal objects.

Return type:

np.ndarray[Decimal]
